SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'A', 1, 4, 2), (2, 'A', 2, 6, 2), (3, NULL, 1, 9, 2)) t(id, product, period, v, w) DECIDE x(INT)
        SUCH THAT x <= 9 AND per t.w: x >= at(first: t.v) over (t.period within t.product) MAXIMIZE sum(x)
